sourceRule: JON-58/JON-80: the first valid accepted ballot is final and cannot be replaced.

schedule.operation: submit valid YES ballot attempt a-1
submit valid NO ballot attempt a-2

adapterObserves: a-2 recorded as duplicate without mutating a-1

sourceRule: JON-58/JON-80: rejection of a malformed attempt does not consume the eligible voter's first valid ballot.

schedule.operation: submit malformed attempt b-1 with unknown choice
submit valid ABSTAIN attempt b-2 before close

adapterObserves: separate records and reasons for b-1 and b-2
only b-2 enters constitutional ballot state

sourceRule: JON-58/JON-80: retries, duplicate submissions, and late attempts remain auditable but cannot mutate an accepted ballot.

schedule.operation: submit valid YES attempt c-1 with idempotency key k1
redeliver c-1 with idempotency key k1
submit valid YES attempt c-2 with key k2
submit valid NO attempt c-3 after close

adapterObserves: retry, new duplicate, and late rejection are distinguishable
accepted receipt and choice never change
